persons.name: Jayajitāmitramalla
persons.evidence: śrīśrīsumatijayajitāmitramallanā thāku rājakurasa bhairavāgni yāyayā tādayakā juroṃ

purpose: bhairavāgni yāyayā (for performing the Bhairavāgni ritual)
notes: King Jayajitāmitramalla of Bhaktapur caused the text to be prepared (Newari: tādayakā juroṃ) for performing the Bhairavāgni ritual in the royal palace (rājakura).
